body:
## Context
Resolves #785.
`listTrackedFiles` in `packages/ticket-prune/lib/detect.mjs` runs `git ls-tree -r --name-only <ref>` and splits on `\n`, allowing a repository with `core.quotePath=false` and a newline-containing filename to inject bogus tracked path entries and flip a non-shipped ticket to shipped.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Update `listTrackedFiles` in `packages/ticket-prune/lib/detect.mjs` to invoke `git(['ls-tree', '-r', '-z', '--name-only', ref], { cwd, encoding: 'buffer' })` and parse the output with `splitNulPaths` from `@adlc/core`.
- Add regression tests in `packages/ticket-prune/test/list-tracked-files.test.mjs` verifying newline-bearing and non-ASCII filenames under `core.quotePath=false` do not split into bogus entries.

## Verify
`node --test packages/ticket-prune/test/list-tracked-files.test.mjs`
title: ticket-prune: use git ls-tree -z and splitNulPaths in listTrackedFiles (#785)
